In addition to radial loads, some axial load can also be carried by the flanges of the inner/outer rings and the roller end faces, making it ideal as a fixed-side bearing; like needle bearings, it is compact. It is available in three types — caged, full-complement, and sheave type — allowing selection according to operating conditions, and it is especially used in construction machinery, industrial machinery, and other applications subject to heavy loads.
en.<strong style=\"color: var(--text);\">유지: Caged type (NAU49 · TRU) — Suitable for locations subject to high-speed rotation and fluctuating loads. The relatively large spacing between rollers assembled in double rows also gives an advantageous structure for moment loads.
en.<strong style=\"color: var(--text);\">총: Full-complement type (NAG49) — Suitable for parts subject to low-speed rotation, oscillating motion, and heavy loads; like the caged type, it has an advantageous structure for moment loads.
en.<strong style=\"color: var(--text);\">시브: Sheave type (NAS50) — A double-row full-complement type with a small cross-sectional height, available in two types: a sealed type with seals and a dust-protected type with shields. At relatively low rotation speeds it withstands large radial and shock loads while also being able to carry axial loads. The outer ring can be easily secured to the sheave with a snap ring.

zh.롤러를 복렬로 조립한 정격 하중이 큰 <strong>비분리형(내외륜이 분: 将滚子组装成双列、额定载荷较大的非分离型(内外圈不可分离的结构)轴承。除径向载荷外，借助内外圈凸缘和滚子端面，还可承受部分轴向载荷，因此非常适合作为固定侧轴承，并且与滚针轴承一样结构紧凑。提供保持架型・满装滚子型・滑轮用型三种方式，可根据使用条件选用，特别适用于承受重载荷的工程机械・产业机械等。
zh.<strong style=\"color: var(--text);\">유지: 保持架型 (NAU49・TRU) — 适用于高速旋转和承受变动载荷的部位。双列组装的滚子间隔较大，因此对力矩也具有有利的结构。
zh.<strong style=\"color: var(--text);\">총: 满装滚子型 (NAG49) — 适用于低速旋转、摆动运动且承受重载荷的部位，与保持架型一样，对力矩具有有利的结构。
zh.<strong style=\"color: var(--text);\">시브: 滑轮用 (NAS50) — 截面高度较小的双列满装滚子形式，分为带密封圈的密封型和带防尘盖的防尘型两种形式，在相对低速旋转下可承受较大的径向载荷和冲击载荷，同时还能承受轴向载荷。外圈可通过卡簧轻松固定在滑轮上。
zh.※ 유지기부착·총 롤러 롤러베어링에는 무봉입(표준형)·밀봉형(그리스 봉입: ※保持架型・满装滚子型滚子轴承分为无密封(标准型)・密封型(内置润滑脂，UU)，滑轮用滚子轴承分为密封型(UUNR)・防尘型(ZZNR，内置润滑脂)。使用温度范围为-20℃~120℃(滑轮用最高110℃)。
